name: 操作の説明を下端に示す業務メガメニュー
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0114 操作の説明を下端に示す業務メガメニュー.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: normalized-original-source-component-crop-768x249. Image 3: secondary-component-preview. Image 4: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Create one standalone Japanese Lighthouse business mega-menu at exactly 768x249 (about 3.08:1), matching the normalized source crop. Image 1 is full source context, image 2 controls the exact source region geometry and five-column spacing, image 3 controls Japanese copy, selection and footer, image 4 controls Lighthouse palette only. Reproduce the five columns and the bottom contextual help strip, with no browser header, page background or extra content. Preserve all text exactly and in order. Column 1: heading 「ショートカット」; links 「管理のホーム」「ホームの一覧」「ショートカットを追加」. Column 2: heading 「コンテンツを作成」; subheading 「有料配信」 with links 「広告用の投稿を作成」「アイデアの広告を作成」; subheading 「通常の投稿」 with links 「投稿を作成」「ボードを作成」「コラージュを作成」. Column 3: heading 「キャンペーンを管理」; one prominent button 「キャンペーンを作成」; then links 「アカウントの概要」「広告の報告」「独自の報告」「広告の提案」「アカウントの履歴」「メディアの予定」「まとめて編集」. Column 4: heading 「成果を分析」; links 「分析の概要」「利用者の傾向」「コンバージョンの状況」「注目の傾向」. Column 5: heading 「ビジネスを管理」; links 「管理の階層」「ビジネスの管理者」「商品一覧とグループ」「コンバージョン」「対象となる相手」「請求」. Bottom strip exact copy: 「キャンペーンを作成：アプリ内に広告のキャンペーンを作成します。」 with the initial phrase in a slightly stronger weight and the explanation regular. Fit all content within the source bounds using compact readable Japanese typography; keep column gutters and line spacing balanced, with no oversized text or excessive whitespace. Use Meiryo-style sans. Main canvas pure white #FFFFFF. Primary campaign button uses the exact gradient 135deg #174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100% with white label. Render the existing help question-mark utility icon in slate #526173. Preserve the existing subtle neutral help-strip background and the original thin column dividers only; no other card backgrounds, chips, badges, imagery, mint wash, added icons or watermark.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Use the exact Lighthouse forest-green gradient only on the existing primary campaign action. Supporting help icon uses #526173. Keep the existing help strip subtly neutral and the rest pure white; no mint wash or extra accents.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION:
The owner says the 354x44 LH07-0025 version was too large/spacious, while the 180x28 version was too compact. Use a comfortable middle with readable Japanese typography and balanced label padding. LH07-0025 v006 at 300x40 is the calibration for that segmented control only; never force this size or the prior 180x28 target onto unrelated components. Follow each component original source for anatomy and component-specific proportions.
reviewNotes: Visually reviewed at normalized 768x249 against original crop and Japanese preview; five columns, exact CTA/footer copy, forest CTA, slate help icon and subtle existing footer surface. Candidate image only; native editing and interaction remain unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
